Nadia, Gideon's July figure for Vantorre Group is 280 seats. I posted that as a reply to your message in #strategic-pod.

His July 1 update first said 300. A few minutes later he corrected it to 280, because the 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins. 280 is the active seat count on the production roster as of Jul 1, and Ruth acknowledged the corrected number in the thread.

That figure is from July 1, so check the CRM if you need today's count.
